s.note: the classic Mother's Day breakfast in bed
s.how: Warm 6 croissants at 160C for 5 minutes. Serve on a tray with 50g butter and a little jar of jam, plus a flower in a glass if you have one.

Mix 200g grated sharp cheddar with 100g mayonnaise, 80g chopped roasted capsicum and a pinch of cayenne. Serve with 200g crackers and celery sticks. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: the big family Mother's Day lunch
m.how: Whisk 8 eggs with 150ml milk. Stir in 150g chopped ham, 100g baby spinach and 100g grated cheese. Pour into a greased dish and bake at 180C for 30 minutes until set. Serve with salad.

w.note: a sweet thank you to mum
w.how: Rub 80g butter into 250g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, add 150ml milk and pat out. Cut 6 rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Split and fill with 300ml whipped cream and 250g sliced strawberries.

d.how: Fill flutes halfway with chilled orange juice and top with sparkling wine. Pour plain orange juice for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
